title: fix: show the wallet, not a key budget, in polli usage
author: Connectslide121

gist.summary: Fixed `polli usage` so `pollen` reports the wallet total from `accountBalance.total`, rather than a budgeted key’s remaining budget. When the key budget differs, the command also prints `key_budget`, matching `polli auth status`; unbudgeted keys retain the same output. The PR bumps `@pollinations/cli` to 0.1.35 and adds a budgeted-key regression test.
